requirements.note: The R2 candidate binds generated physical Git worktrees and tests identity drift; hosted matrix and merge acceptance remain external to this local descriptor.
Exact-preimage structural replacement and exclusive creation are locally exercised; this candidate does not claim later delete, move, checkpoint, or durable-recovery behavior.
Direct executable-plus-argv verification is bounded and approval-gated locally; no filesystem or network sandbox is claimed.
The R2 event and terminal paths preserve bounded stdout/stderr channel and sequence facts; durable output artifacts remain a later gate.
Initial HEAD, branch, status and index facts are captured before approved edits, and the safety oracle proves Robin performs no Git mutation.
Raw and flat candidate views expose ordered assistant, approval, tool and process activity; the stable R7 automation and supported terminal matrix are not implied.

supportedClaims: This manifest records local deterministic R2 candidate commands at the tested commit; it does not by itself establish R2 acceptance.

Generated temporary Git repository package tests exercise bounded physical list, literal search, classified read, exact-preimage replacement, exclusive creation, direct process execution, and read-only status/diff; the deterministic provider-neutral application loop invokes list/search/read, two exact-preimage replacements, two direct verifications, and final status/diff, but does not invoke create_file.
Every R2 edit and process effect requires a separately displayed one-use approval; headless mode denies approval requests because it has no trusted human response channel.
The candidate explicitly reports that approved processes are unsandboxed and have no filesystem or network isolation.
The reviewed development tarball passes isolated install, installed R1 compatibility PTY, installed R2 approval workflow, exact repository safety, terminal restoration, and uninstall checks.
deferredClaims: R2 acceptance, hosted Linux/macOS results, branch protection, reviewed-head linkage, merge identity, and merge-triggered mainline results are external records not established by this local manifest.
A production model provider, arbitrary provider or agent compatibility, API-key onboarding, credential storage, local model endpoint, or network transport is not established by R2.
Durable sessions, continuation, resume, crash recovery, persistent approvals, background supervision, and editor clients are not established by R2.
Strict process isolation, shell command text, network tools, workspace executables, file delete/move, Git stage/commit/branch/push/PR, and isolated worktrees are not established by R2.
A public npm publication, supported installer, upgrade, rollback, migration, signed release artifact, or production uninstall guarantee is not established by R2.

knownLimitations.summary: The commit field identifies the clean source commit tested before the generated manifest file is written.
knownLimitations.impact: A later manifest commit intentionally points to its tested source parent and never claims to hash itself.

knownLimitations.summary: The generated local manifest records one host environment only.
knownLimitations.impact: It does not replace separately required hosted Linux and macOS PTY, repository, and package evidence.

knownLimitations.summary: The R2 model recognizes one exact deterministic two-defect TypeScript fixture and derives each next action from provider-neutral observations.
knownLimitations.impact: R2 proves the coding architecture and effect boundaries, not arbitrary natural-language coding competence or provider compatibility.

knownLimitations.summary: Approved edits target the live bound worktree and approved processes run directly on the host with no filesystem or network isolation.
knownLimitations.impact: Users must review exact approvals and use a disposable or otherwise reviewed repository; strict isolation remains R5.

knownLimitations.summary: Conversation state, edit attribution and approval grants exist only for the running process.
knownLimitations.impact: A restart cannot resume or reconstruct authority; durable state and recovery remain R3.

knownLimitations.summary: JSON and streaming-JSON envelopes explicitly declare experimental stability.
knownLimitations.impact: R7, not R2, owns stable automation schemas and multi-provider conformance.

knownLimitations.summary: The process-level PTY harness uses the operating-system Python 3 standard library.
knownLimitations.impact: Python is a contributor and CI test dependency, not a runtime dependency of the packed Robin CLI.

knownLimitations.summary: The R2 package inventory pins measured macOS-arm64 npm 10/11 and Linux-x64 npm 10 gzip profiles plus the platform-independent canonical tar contents.
knownLimitations.impact: The archive is temporary, unsigned and unpublished; immutable release provenance remains R10.

knownLimitations.summary: Evidence schema v1 records partial requirement progress only.
knownLimitations.impact: No requirement is marked complete solely because the R2 candidate or this manifest exists.
